subject: Dedicated capacity architecture review — confirm attendees & timing
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finopt.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Moran <alex.moran@finopt.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: architecture review for dedicated GPU capacity (sizing, autoscale, isolation)

Hi Chloe / Karthik,

Thanks again for the intro last week. FinOpt is close to committing to a Dedicated deployment and our infra leadership wants a focused architecture review before signing the SOW. Can we schedule a technical deep-dive next week that covers:
- pool sizing methodology (per-model qps and burst scenarios)
- autoscaling triggers, cooldowns, and warm-up strategies
- isolation and tenancy patterns (VM-level vs CUDA namespace vs node eviction behavior)
- fallback routing and cross-region failover

Proposed windows (PT): Tue 8/24 10:00-11:30, Wed 8/25 09:00-10:30, or Thu 8/26 13:00-14:30. We'll need ~90 mins with at least one infra lead and our platform PM.

Attendees from FinOpt: Priya (Sponsoring PM), Alex (Solutions), Ethan (infra lead — may be on PTO but we'll confirm).

Are you able to confirm a slot and an internal list for the session? Also, if you have a short checklist or pre-read we can circulate, please share.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Product
FinOpt Analytics

From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finopt.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture review for dedicated GPU capacity (sizing, autoscale, isolation)

Hi Priya — thanks, this is perfect.

We can absolutely run the session. Suggested plan: 90-minute technical deep-dive with the following agenda (we'll circulate a one-pager pre-read by EOD Monday):
1) 15m — Goals & customer constraints (you + Priya)
2) 25m — Pool sizing approach (k8s node sizing vs slab reservation; model profile examples)
3) 20m — Autoscale mechanics (trigger heuristics, queue/backpressure, cooldown, warm vs cold start)
4) 20m — Isolation & tenancy options (soft vs hard isolation, eviction strategies, multi-tenant KV cache behavior)
5) 10m — Fallbacks & SLA implications + next steps

Internal joining: Karthik (inference architect) + Ben (ops/runbooks) + Lauren (customer success).

From your proposed times, Tue 8/24 10:00-11:30 PT works best for the internal team. If that suits you, I'll send a calendar invite and attach the pre-read and a short runbook stub.

Quick ask for prep: can you share a representative request profile (avg qps, 99th-latency target, token lengths) and confirm whether your models will be quantized/8-bit? That will help us prepare sizing scenarios.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

On Fri, Aug 21, 2026 at 11:22 AM Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
> Subject: Re: Request: architecture review for dedicated GPU capacity (sizing, autoscale, isolation)
>
> We can absolutely run the session...

Thanks Chloe — adding a few notes so the prep is focused:
- Please ask FinOpt to include a peak-day QPS profile and a short list of 3 representative prompts (token counts) per model. That lets us build both per-model and aggregate headroom.
- We'll prepare two sizing buckets (steady-state vs 3x burst) and a quick cost delta for different quantization profiles (fp16 vs int8).
- For autoscale, I'll demo how our concurrent request queue and target latency SLO feeds into scale-up decisions; Ben will cover runbook-triggered manual scaling and maintenance windows.
- Isolation: recommend we discuss node-level preemption policies and a preferred approach for strict tenant isolation (dedicated node pools + network policy) vs soft isolation (multi-tenant with QoS).

I'll create a brief prep doc and upload it to the shared drive tonight. Priya — if you can drop the requested numbers, we'll bake them into the examples.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Inference Architect
Redwood Inference
